train_tree_encoder_model: train a tree encoder model using GNN and decoder with DGL batched graphs and optimizer
test_tree_encoder_model: test a tree encoder model by evaluating loss and accuracy on an iterator of batches
calculate_performance_metrics: calculate cross entropy loss and word-level accuracy with optional label smoothing for predictions
preprocess_tree_graphs: preprocess tree-structured data into DGL graphs with node annotations and edge types for caching
compute_positional_encoding: compute novel positional encoding for tree nodes based on branch index and parent encoding
